works.title: Masculine-Stillness Romance Fiction
works.description: A romance fiction work exploring a philosophical theme: that the true test of a gentleman's character is his ability to remain still, and that even the slightest form of coercion is poisonous to relationship. The user is developing narrative architecture with dual-ending format and specific scenes (e.g., 'After the Fire' scene), establishing a frame where masculine stillness (without chasing, begging, or manipulation) becomes the romantic ideal.
works.quote: In my romance story and this fictional stories that I want to write, I think that my theme should be that the test of character of a gentleman is the ability to remain still, and only to invite even the such smallest form of coercion is poisonous to the relationship

works.title: Visceral-Imagist Writing Vocabulary System
works.description: A specialized vocabulary library and methodology for fiction writing, developed with AI assistance. The system organizes concrete nouns and bodily verbs by emotional/sensory properties (color, temperature, texture, tactile qualities), cross-references terms, and documents conditions where specific words succeed or fail. Designed to enable rapid writing through vocabulary combination rather than becoming sterile through repetition.
works.quote: I would need a self-curated library with AI assistance that gives me a list of terms, noting conditions where they may or may not be appropriate, or where they fail for specific reasons. Each term could cross-reference with others.
